products.name: Highland Red Bell Peppers
products.description: Sweet, crisp bell peppers harvested fresh in Tupi foothills.

products.name: Salad Tomatoes
products.description: Firm, sweet salad tomatoes harvested at dawn in Polomolok. Ideal for sinigang, salsa, and everyday cooking.

products.name: Fresh Kangkong
products.description: Crisp water spinach bunches from Koronadal paddies, washed and bundled the same morning.

products.name: Carabao Mangoes
products.description: Export-grade sweet Carabao mangoes from Midsayap. Tree-ripened, golden yellow, and fragrant.

products.name: Lakatan Bananas
products.description: Sweet, golden Lakatan bananas freshly harvested from orchards near General Santos City.

products.name: Dinorado Rice
products.description: Aromatic whole-grain Dinorado rice from the plains of M'lang. Soft, fluffy texture when cooked.

products.name: Sweet Yellow Corn
products.description: Juicy, golden sweet corn cobs from South Cotabato farms. Great for boiling or grilling.

products.name: Free-Range Brown Eggs
products.description: Fresh pastured eggs from cage-free hens in Koronadal. Thick shells, rich orange yolks.

products.name: Lake Sebu Fresh Tilapia
products.description: Cold-water spring tilapia freshly harvested from Lake Sebu pens. Clean taste with no mud flavor.

products.name: Native Whole Chicken
products.description: Free-range native chicken raised on grass and corn. Superior taste and firmness for authentic tinola.

products.name: Fresh Juicy Calamansi
products.description: High-yield aromatic calamansi from Alabel orchards. Bursting with vitamin C for drinks and marinades.

products.name: Vermicast Organic Fertilizer
products.description: 100% pure worm castings (vermicompost). Highly concentrated microbial inoculant to revitalize garden and farm soil.

products.name: Hybrid Ampalaya Seeds
products.description: High germination (92%) disease-resistant bitter gourd seeds. Tested for SOCCSKSARGEN highland and lowland plots.

products.name: Fresh Carabao Milk
products.description: Creamy, unpasteurized natural carabao milk collected at 5:00 AM. Ideal for kesong puti and pasture pastillas.

products.name: Fresh Puyat Durian
products.description: King of Fruits! Creamy, bittersweet Puyat durian from Mount Apo volcanic soils in Kidapawan.

products.name: Sweet Highland Mangosteen
products.description: Queen of Fruits! Juicy, snow-white arils packed with potent xanthones and natural antioxidants.

products.name: Long Purple Eggplant (Talong)
products.description: Glossy, tender long purple eggplants picked fresh every morning. Perfect for tortang talong and pinakbet.

products.name: Organic Ampalaya (Bitter Gourd)
products.description: Crisp green bitter melons cultivated without chemical sprays. Excellent for blood sugar management and ginisang ampalaya.

products.name: Supreme Squash (Kalabasa)
products.description: Thick, creamy yellow flesh squash with high carotene content. Great for ginataang kalabasa and healthy hearty stews.

products.name: Red Creole Onions (Sibuyas)
products.description: Pungent, dry-cured red onions from Sultan Kudarat plains. Excellent keeping quality and savory richness.

products.name: Native White Garlic (Bawang)
products.description: Intensely fragrant native Philippine garlic cloves. Packed with natural allicin, vital for sautéing and home medicine.

products.name: Fresh Yellow Ginger (Luya)
products.description: Spicy highland ginger rhizomes. Plump and fiber-rich, essential for tinola, salabat, and seafood marinades.

products.name: Organic Black Rice (Tapol)
products.description: Ancestral heirloom black rice rich in anthocyanins. Nutty flavor, low glycemic index, favored by health enthusiasts.

products.name: Fresh Boneless Bangus
products.description: Plump Sarangani Bay milkfish, deboned and packed immediately on flake ice. Tender, rich belly fat.

products.name: Pure Wild Forest Honey
products.description: Raw, unheated multifloral wild bee honey harvested sustainably from the forested slopes of Mount Matutum.

products.name: Hydroponic Romaine Lettuce
products.description: Crisp, sweet butterhead and romaine heads grown in pristine mountain water nutrient film technique (NFT). Zero soil grit.

products.name: Fresh White Oyster Mushrooms
products.description: Succulent oyster mushrooms cultivated on pasteurized sawdust and rice bran substrate. Excellent vegan meat substitute.

products.name: Red Lady Sweet Papaya
products.description: Tree-ripened Red Lady hybrid papayas. Dense orange-red pulp, intensely sweet with very few seeds.

products.name: Red Flesh Dragon Fruit
products.description: Vibrant magenta-fleshed pitahaya harvested at peak ripeness. Juicy, rich in dietary fiber and prebiotics.
